h1: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Bangalore

h1Text: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Bangalore

items.pText: Many play areas in Bangalore are built on a podium slab between apartment towers rather than on open ground. FunPlay Systems designs and manufactures outdoor playground equipment for these gated communities, and for schools, parks and corporate campuses across the city. We make everything at our factory in Vasai East, about 870 km away, and send it to Bangalore by road.

Our installation team or a local dealer sets up the equipment on your site. The large residential projects along Sarjapur Road, Whitefield, Hebbal, Electronic City and Kanakapura Road each need a play area for several age groups, often on a fixed plot shown in the brochure. International and CBSE schools want equipment that takes a full school day of use. We help with both, from the first layout drawing to installation.

On a podium, the waterproofing below the slab must not be damaged, so drilling deep into it is usually not an option. In these cases we install the equipment self-standing, on a base that spreads the load, instead of grouting it. Share the slab details and photos with us early, so your structural consultant can check the load before we finalise the layout.

Rubber flooring is the usual surface on a podium. It cushions falls and protects the slab, and we supply it along with the equipment. Keep a strip of open floor between the play zone and any planters or water features, so children running off a slide have room to stop.

richText.heading: Year-round play in a mild climate

c: Bangalore's weather lets children play outdoors in almost every month, which means the equipment sees more hours of use than in hotter cities. Heavy showers come with the southwest monsoon and again in October and November, so the play area still needs a drainage slope. Water left standing on a podium can also find its way through joints in the waterproofing, which is one more reason to keep the surface draining well.

Plan a monthly check of bolts, swing hangers and spring riders, and follow the maintenance steps we share at handover. Galvanised pipes and roto-moulded parts carry a 3-year warranty, and springs and bearings carry 1 year.

items.q: Can playground equipment be installed on a podium slab?
items.a: Yes. We use a self-standing method that does not need deep drilling into the slab. Share the slab details and photos so your consultant can confirm the load before we finalise the layout.

items.q: Do you deliver and install in Bangalore?
items.a: Yes. We make the equipment at our Vasai factory, about 870 km away, send it by road and install it with our own team or a local dealer.

items.q: How do you plan a play area for different age groups?
items.a: We separate toddler pieces such as spring riders and low slides from the larger structures meant for older children. Each zone gets its own safe play area on the layout drawing.

items.q: Can you match the colours to our project?
items.a: Yes. Our roto-moulded parts come in 15+ colour shades, and design customisation is possible on request. Tell us your colour scheme when you share the site details.
